cohort: 20,593 singleton pregnant women at the Beijing Obstetrics and Gynaecology Hospital from January 1, 2018, to December 31, 2019
finding: The 2009 Institute of Medicine (IOM) gestational weight gain (GWG) guidelines were suitable for Chinese women with underweight pre-pregnancy body mass index, but not for those with normal weight, overweight, or obese pre-pregnancy body mass index.
